name: bindSources
reason: Pure request-time evaluation of a manifest's source bindings
hostAction: Call it before resolving sources; it resolves no data and grants no authority.

name: renderKey
reason: Stable re-run cache key over a render's inputs
hostAction: Optional: skip a re-run and the transfer when the key is unchanged.

name: auditContrast
reason: Recipe-derived contrast audit over the catalogue's resolved pairs
hostAction: Optional: run it at install time and gate the result; it changes no installation.

name: designSystemSuite
reason: Optional contrast: true | { minimums } turns audit findings into failures

name: createRenderer
reason: SurfaceProps gains an optional focusContinuity boolean (task 7) and its onIntent return widens from void to unknown (task 8), so a host callback may return a promise emit hands back

name: states
reason: gains current, mixed, pending and readonly, placed between selected and invalid in source order
hostAction: Use Partial, or a default branch, for exhaustive Record<(typeof states)[number], ...> maps; a system styling none of the new states projects the same CSS.

name: design-system.json
reason: Recipe key pattern accepts the four new states

name: ImplementationProps
reason: Emit returns Promise<void> | undefined, the host's promise when onIntent returns one
hostAction: none: ignoring the result, or assigning emit to a void-returning function type, still compiles.

name: ref
reason: Author-side node reference marker; the design is ratified but ships in 0.3.0 (decision log 2026-11-02-1219)

name: NodeRef
reason: Documentation alias for a reference prop value; ships with ref() in 0.3.0

name: catalog.json
reason: Optional refProps name list per definition; ships with ref() in 0.3.0
